mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react quickly to the positive economic news.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns following RSAFS increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a rising federal funds rate and a falling consumer price index signals a potential deflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and falling nonfarm payrolls signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.5% and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between GDPC1 declines and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
